title: unified-rollouts: staged shadow + canary auto-rollback workflow
author: Priya Singh
description: This PR implements a staged rollout workflow that combines shadow probing with progressive canary traffic and metric-driven automatic rollback. Motivation: reduce risk of regressions when promoting models across environments by running a lightweight probing stage (shadow) against production traffic, followed by a staged canary with configurable metric thresholds and quorum-based decisioning. The change includes: 1) controller changes to orchestrate staged rolls (shadow -> probe window -> canary ramp -> promote/rollback), 2) new policy config for metric quorums and multi-metric thresholds, 3) observability hooks and rollout events for tracing (span tags, rollout_id), 4) e2e integration tests for staged shadow + canary flows, and 5) migration to support backward-compatible rollout objects for existing pipelines. Design notes: - Shadow stage runs a configurable fraction of requests to the candidate model (no response to users) and records probe metrics. - Probe stage can quarantine candidate automatically if probe metrics cross quarantine thresholds. - Canary stage ramps traffic in configurable steps with stabilization windows; a quorum evaluator aggregates metrics from multiple telemetry sources (latency, error_rate, quality_score) to decide continue/promote/rollback. - Auto-rollback supports soft (scale down traffic) and hard (immediate full rollback) modes based on severity and policy. - Added safeguards: max-unhealthy-samples, min-sample-size, and cooldown between roll steps to avoid thrashing. Backwards compatibility: existing rollout specs without staged config default to the current canary-only behavior. This PR intentionally limits surface changes to the rollout controller and observability integration; serving runtime kernel selection is unchanged. Checklist: - [x] Controller implementation - [x] Quorum evaluator and metric wiring - [x] Observability events and tracing - [x] e2e integration tests against k8s test harness - [x] Documentation update in redwood-docs (separate small doc PR referenced) Related: ENG-1489 (spec), SUP-3421 (customer incident that motivated quarantine flow).
